meta.description:
Vietnam is now growing between tourist and in this video I will show you some beautiful places of vietnam ninh binh, hanoi, train street, halong bay and many more places. I will also provide information about vietnam visa rules and many important information about vietnam trip. So after watching this video you can easily plan your vietnam trip.

Vietnam indian tourist ke bich kafi popular destination ban chuki hai aur is video me mai aapko vietnam ki tourist places jaise hanoi ki train street, halong bay aur ninh binh jaisi places ke alawa bhi kafi kuch dikhaunga aur vietnam visa ki jankari bhi dunga. comments.author: @dr.ajay2911
comments.text: Hi, is the package offered by Lily Travels reasonable? I have contacted them, and their offer seems a little too costly, as compared to self-planned bookings. Please suggest.

comments.author: @Distancebetweenbyshubh
comments.text:
A self-planned trip usually turns out cheaper, but you have to handle multiple bookings and plan the itinerary yourself. Lily’s services are good though, because I’ve taken packages from them twice. Even when the flight arrives early in the morning and the hotel doesn’t allow early check-in, they have a really nice office in Hanoi where you can freshen up.
The cost is higher mainly because they also have their profit margins. So, if you want more comfort and a smooth trip without the headache of managing different bookings, a package is a good option. Otherwise, if you feel you can make huge savings, you can definitely plan the trip on your own.

comments.text: Vietnam is a fantastic destination, and India could take a few cues on how to develop tourism in a sustainable and welcoming way. Take Hoi An, for example — such a simple concept, yet incredibly beautiful and well maintained. The local food is outstanding, and the people are genuinely warm and helpful. Even when they don’t speak English, they go out of their way to assist you. Of all the countries I've traveled to, these 15 days in Vietnam have been among the most memorable.

1) Hanoi:
2) Grand World
3) Train Street
4) Halong Bay (bus till Halong 150km, cruise to Bay)
     i) day trip  3 - 4.5k
     ii) 1N 2D 8 - 11k
5) Ngoc Son temple
6) Old quarter
7) Nin Binh (90km from Hanoi, day trip 3-4k)
     i) Hoa Lu
     ii) Tam Coc (boating)
     iii) Hang Mua
